name: ipconfig /all

name: ipconfig /release · /renew

name: ipconfig /displaydns
purpose: View the DNS cache

name: netsh
purpose: Configure interfaces, Wi-Fi and firewall
note: Configuration changes are copy-only; the read-only views below are runnable.

name: getmac

name: Proxy settings (user)
purpose: The proxy and auto-config script your Windows account is set to use

run.command: Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' | Select-Object ProxyEnable, ProxyServer, AutoConfigURL, ProxyOverride | Format-List

name: ping
purpose: Test whether a host is reachable

name: tracert
purpose: Show the path packets take to a host

name: pathping
purpose: Traceroute plus packet-loss stats (takes a few minutes)

name: route print
purpose: Show the routing table

name: route add · delete
purpose: Add or remove routes
note: Alters the routing table — copy and run it yourself.

name: netstat -ano
purpose: Active connections, listening ports and owning process IDs

name: Get-NetTCPConnection
purpose: List open network connections

presets.label: -State Listen — listening ports only
presets.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 4096

presets.label: -State Established — live connections only
presets.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Sort-Object RemoteAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 4096

name: Test-NetConnection
purpose: Test whether a specific port is open on a host

name: Quick TCP port test
purpose: Test one TCP port with a 5-second limit — answers open, refused or timeout (faster than Test-NetConnection)

run.command: $h = '{host}'; $p = {port}; $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); $c = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { $t = $c.ConnectAsync($h, $p); if ($t.Wait(5000)) { $r = if ($c.Connected) { 'open' } else { 'refused' } } else { $r = 'timeout' } } catch { $m = $_.Exception.GetBaseException().Message; $r = if ($m -match 'refused') { 'refused' } elseif ($m -match 'No such host|not known') { 'dns-failure' } else { 'error: ' + $m } } finally { $c.Close() }; [pscustomobject]@{ Target = $h; Port = $p; Result = $r; Millis = $sw.ElapsedMilliseconds } | Format-List

name: arp -a
purpose: Show the ARP cache — IP-to-MAC mappings on your LAN

name: arp -d *
purpose: Clear the ARP cache
note: Flushes neighbor state and needs admin rights — run it yourself.

name: Get-WinEvent (address conflicts)
purpose: Recent "IP address conflict" events from the System log

run.command: $e = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; ProviderName = 'Tcpip'; Id = 4199 } -MaxEvents 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($e.Count) { $e | Select-Object @{n='When';e={$_.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')}}, Message | Format-List } else { 'No address-conflict events found.' }

name: Local network scan
purpose: Find every device on your own network: pings all addresses in your subnet at once, then adds MAC addresses and names
note: Scans only the private subnet this PC is on (at most 254 addresses). There is nothing to type, and it refuses to run on a public address.
win: Ping sweep of your local subnet (PowerShell)

run.display: Ping sweep of your local subnet + ARP table
run.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); $routes = @(Get-NetRoute -AddressFamily IPv4 -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' | Sort-Object RouteMetric, InterfaceMetric); $me = $null; $gw = $null; foreach ($r in $routes) { $a = @(Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceIndex $r.InterfaceIndex -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254.*' -and $_.AddressState -eq 'Preferred' }); if ($a.Count) { $me = $a[0]; $gw = $r.NextHop; break } }; if (-not $me) { 'SCAN-ERROR: no active network adapter with an IPv4 address was found.'; exit 1 }; $o = @($me.IPAddress.Split('.') | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ }); $private = ($o[0] -eq 10) -or ($o[0] -eq 192 -and $o[1] -eq 168) -or ($o[0] -eq 172 -and $o[1] -ge 16 -and $o[1] -le 31); if (-not $private) { 'SCAN-ERROR: this adapter has a public address (' + $me.IPAddress + '). NetDeck only scans private local networks.'; exit 1 }; $prefix = [int]$me.PrefixLength; if ($prefix -lt 24) { $prefix = 24 }; $size = [int][math]::Pow(2, 32 - $prefix); $start = [int]([math]::Floor($o[3] / $size) * $size); $first = $start + 1; $last = $start + $size - 2; if ($last -lt $first) { 'SCAN-ERROR: this subnet is too small to scan.'; exit 1 }; $base = [string]$o[0] + '.' + $o[1] + '.' + $o[2] + '.'; $targets = @($first..$last | ForEach-Object { $base + $_ }); $jobs = foreach ($t in $targets) { $p = New-Object System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping; [pscustomobject]@{ IP = $t; Task = $p.SendPingAsync($t, 1000) } }; try { [void][System.Threading.Tasks.Task]::WaitAll([System.Threading.Tasks.Task[]]@($jobs | ForEach-Object { $_.Task }), 8000) } catch { }; $alive = @{}; foreach ($j in $jobs) { if ($j.Task.Status -eq 'RanToCompletion' -and $j.Task.Result.Status -eq 'Success') { $alive[$j.IP] = $j.Task.Result.RoundtripTime } }; $macs = @{}; Get-NetNeighbor -AddressFamily IPv4 -InterfaceIndex $me.InterfaceIndex | Where-Object { $_.State -ne 'Unreachable' -and $_.State -ne 'Incomplete' -and $_.LinkLayerAddress -and $_.LinkLayerAddress -notmatch '^(FF-FF|00-00-00-00|01-00-5E)' } | ForEach-Object { $macs[$_.IPAddress] = $_.LinkLayerAddress }; $myMac = (Get-NetAdapter -InterfaceIndex $me.InterfaceIndex).MacAddress; $found = @($targets | Where-Object { $alive.ContainsKey($_) -or $macs.ContainsKey($_) }); if (-not ($found -contains $me.IPAddress)) { $found += $me.IPAddress }; $look = foreach ($f in $found) { [pscustomobject]@{ IP = $f; Task = [System.Net.Dns]::GetHostEntryAsync($f) } }; try { [void][System.Threading.Tasks.Task]::WaitAll([System.Threading.Tasks.Task[]]@($look | ForEach-Object { $_.Task }), 4000) } catch { }; $names = @{}; foreach ($l in $look) { if ($l.Task.Status -eq 'RanToCompletion') { $n = $l.Task.Result.HostName; if ($n -and $n -ne $l.IP -and $n -notmatch 'docker\.internal$') { $names[$l.IP] = $n } } }; $rows = @(foreach ($f in ($found | Sort-Object { [int]($_.Split('.')[3]) })) { $note = ''; if ($f -eq $me.IPAddress) { $note = 'this PC' } elseif ($f -eq $gw) { $note = 'router' }; $mac = [string]$macs[$f]; if ($f -eq $me.IPAddress) { $mac = [string]$myMac }; $ping = 'no reply'; if ($alive.ContainsKey($f)) { $ping = 'replied' }; [pscustomobject]@{ IP = $f; Name = [string]$names[$f]; MAC = $mac; Ping = $ping; Note = $note } }); 'Scanned ' + $base + $first + '-' + $last + ' on ' + $me.InterfaceAlias + ' in ' + [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 1) + ' s: ' + $rows.Count + ' devices found'; $rows | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 4096

name: nmap
purpose: Port and host scanning
note: Usually not installed, and only for hosts you're authorized to scan.

name: pktmon / tcpdump
purpose: Packet capture
note: Captures traffic and needs admin rights — run it yourself.

name: curl / wget
purpose: HTTP requests and downloads (curl is built into Windows 10/11)

args: dns %{time_namelookup}s  connect %{time_connect}s  tls %{time_appconnect}s  first byte %{time_starttransfer}s  total %{time_total}s  status %{http_code}\n

presets.label: -w timing — DNS / connect / TLS / total seconds
args: dns %{time_namelookup}s  connect %{time_connect}s  tls %{time_appconnect}s  first byte %{time_starttransfer}s  total %{time_total}s  status %{http_code}\n

name: TLS certificate check
purpose: Show who issued a site's certificate, when it expires, and whether Windows trusts it

run.command: $h = '{host}'; $c = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $c.Connect($h, 443); $s = New-Object Net.Security.SslStream($c.GetStream(), $false, { $true }); $s.AuthenticateAsClient($h); $x = New-Object Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2($s.RemoteCertificate); [pscustomobject]@{ Subject = $x.Subject; Issuer = $x.Issuer; ValidFrom = $x.NotBefore.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); ValidTo = $x.NotAfter.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); DaysLeft = [int]($x.NotAfter - (Get-Date)).TotalDays; Protocol = $s.SslProtocol; TrustedByWindows = $x.Verify() } | Format-List; $c.Close()

name: ssh · scp · sftp
purpose: Remote shell and file copy (built into Windows 10/11)
note: Interactive session — open a terminal for this one.

name: whois
purpose: Domain registration lookup
note: Not installed on Windows by default (Sysinternals has one).

name: iperf3
purpose: Bandwidth testing between two hosts
note: Needs an iperf3 server on the other end — run it yourself.

name: tasklist / taskkill
purpose: List processes (taskkill ends them — copy only)

name: tasklist /fo csv
purpose: Process list as CSV (used internally to map PIDs to process names)

name: systeminfo
purpose: OS, hardware and patch details (takes ~20s)

name: Uptime & memory
purpose: Windows version, days since the last reboot, and how much memory is free

run.command: $o = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; [pscustomobject]@{ OS = $o.Caption; Version = $o.Version; LastBoot = $o.LastBootUpTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'); UptimeDays = [math]::Round(((Get-Date) - $o.LastBootUpTime).TotalDays, 1); MemoryTotalGB = [math]::Round($o.TotalVisibleMemorySize / 1MB, 1); MemoryFreeGB = [math]::Round($o.FreePhysicalMemory / 1MB, 1) } | Format-List

name: Disk free space
purpose: Size and free space of each fixed drive

name: Get-HotFix
purpose: Most recently installed Windows updates

run.command: Get-HotFix | Where-Object InstalledOn | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Select-Object -First 8 HotFixID, Description, @{n='Installed';e={$_.InstalledOn.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')}}, @{n='DaysAgo';e={[int]((Get-Date) - $_.InstalledOn).TotalDays}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 4096

name: sfc /scannow · chkdsk
purpose: Check system files and disks
note: Repairs system state and needs admin rights — run it yourself.

name: whoami
purpose: Current user and privileges
